doc.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11

title: Record collectors, a visiting French writer and Mike Kaplan
summary: Talk of record historians, a writer visiting from Paris, and Mike Kaplan who still plays.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: That's the same way in New York. I got kids around there that not only write books and have, oh, when they want to find out anything I can ask them. They have all of the data and they got so many books of all the bands of all the country. Not in New Orleans, but all over the country, you know. That's the one that got me those English records. I didn't know they were existing. Well, you know there's a second one.
Yeah, I got two of them. There's a boy just come over from Paris, come over to see me. He's writing a book on that.
I saw him in the... Kaplan showed me a letter from him. Mike Kaplan showed me a letter from him.
Yeah, so he wrote me a letter from him.
Some pictures I just sent him.
What was it? What? Yeah, he's in the Shrinas.
That's right. Oh, he's a big man in the Shrinas in those days. That's right. I know that name meant something. Well, he doesn't play music anymore.
He plays for the Shrinas. I had his picture in the paper.
